title: `jax.jit + jnp.log2 + jnp.exp2`: jit(log2(exp2(x))) hides exp2 overflow — XLA rewrites log2(exp2(x)) to x
author: JamesDLance

comments.author: jakevdp
comments.body: Hi - in general `jax.jit` does not promise bitwise equivalence of floating point operations compared to the eagerly-evaluated versions. Normal floating point arithmetic rules apply (i.e. different ways of expressing the "same" computation will result in different rounding errors). As such, I think this is working as expected.
